questions.prompt: What should “rows, cols” store after this step?

choices.label: Option A
choices.feedback: This stores “((len(matrix)) + 1), len(matrix[0])” in “rows, cols”. On this test, it raises IndexError: list index out of range; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].

choices.label: Option B
choices.feedback: This stores “((len(matrix)) - 1), len(matrix[0])” in “rows, cols”. On this test, it returns [[1,4],[2,5],[3,6]]; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].

choices.label: Option C
choices.feedback: This stores “len(matrix), ((len(matrix[0])) - 1)” in “rows, cols”. On this test, it returns [[1,4,7],[2,5,8]]; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].

choices.label: Option D
choices.feedback: Set “rows” to the length of “matrix”. Set “cols” to the length of “matrix[0]”. Calculate these values before writing any of the targets.

choices.label: Option A
choices.code: return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[::-1]
choices.feedback: This uses “return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[::-1]” instead of “return [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]”. On this test, it returns [[3,6,9],[2,5,8],[1,4,7]]; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].

choices.label: Option B
choices.code: return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[:-1]
choices.feedback: This uses “return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[:-1]” instead of “return [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]”. On this test, it returns [[1,4,7],[2,5,8]]; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].

choices.label: Option C
choices.code: return [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]
choices.feedback: Return “[[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]” and stop this call.

choices.label: Option D
choices.code: return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[1:]
choices.feedback: This uses “return ([[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)])[1:]” instead of “return [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(rows)] for i in range(cols)]”. On this test, it returns [[2,5,8],[3,6,9]]; the expected result is [[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[3,6,9]].
